content: Spice essence is a fictional substance originating from the Dune universe, created by Frank Herbert. It is described as a bright blue liquid, which is a concentrated form of melange. Melange itself is a substance derived from the giant sandworms found on the desert planet Arrakis. Spice essence has a distinctive odor, characterized as bitter cinnamon by Murbella in Chapterhouse: Dune. After the transformation of Dune into Arrakis and the extinction of the sandworms, spice essence appears to have replaced the Water of Life in the rituals of the Fremen and the Bene Gesserit. Due to its concentrated nature, spice essence is utilized in many of the same ways as melange. Spacing Guild The Spacing Guild Navigators use spice essence to enter a prescient trance, which enables them to perceive the flow of time. This trance is essential for a Navigator to chart the safest course through space-time, avoiding collisions with objects of mass. This ability is critical for piloting Heighliners, the massive starships used for interstellar travel. Bene Gesserit The Bene Gesserit employ spice essence as a key component in the ritual known as the spice agony. This ritual allows a Bene Gesserit to potentially access her Other Memory, a repository of ancestral memories. To survive the spice agony, the individual must use her Bene Gesserit-trained metabolic control to chemically alter the essence, neutralizing its toxic properties. Successfully completing this process unlocks ancestral memories, while failure results in death. Historically, only two men have ever consumed spice essence and survived: Paul Atreides, the Kwisatz Haderach, and his son, Leto Atreides II.
